notes.title: Fixed launch bug
notes.content: Fixed a bug that would cause players to crash upon opening the game

notes.title: DEAD GAME update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

CANDLES is 25% off this week and I added a couple of new features.
 - Nightmare mode is now unlockable after completing normal mode (previously was available off-rip)

 - 5 new achievements have been added!

 HEARTY - Complete normal mode without taking damage
 CLOCKWORK - Complete normal mode under 7 minutes
 SHACKLED - Complete normal mode without sprinting
 NIGHTMARISH - Complete nightmare mode
 PINCH YOURSELF - Complete nightmare mode under 7 minutes
Bug fixes and performance
 Fixed a bug where the basement door was visible in every room
 Reduced the file size by 28% to 188.1MB
